verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at auth0.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and markdown versions of the docs pages, each with a documentation index pointing agents back to llms.txt. Auth0 also publishes llms-full.txt for the docs, changelog and case studies, a blog llms.txt, many .md feature pages, and an agent-experience page offering installable Agent Skills. Missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents successfully using these llms.txt and markdown docs in practice.
